summary: A Yes vote enacts a 0.5% transactions and use (sales) tax in the City of Berkeley for general municipal purposes, estimated to raise more than $9 million per year.

tax.text: A Yes vote on Measure V would raise Berkeley’s sales tax by 0.5% to generate about $9–10 million annually for general-fund services, including public safety.
tax.quote: Measure V — Sales Tax for the General Fund: SUPPORT

tax.text: Argued against Measure V, which would impose a half-cent sales tax.
